name: amux
description: Check on and message your amux coding agents and manage their task board from ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Check on and message your amux workers and board
interface.longDescription: amux runs many AI coding agents (workers) in parallel on your machine or in amux cloud. Connect it to ChatGPT to see which workers are running, read what a worker is doing, send a worker a message, and add or move cards on the task board. You approve every connection in amux and can disconnect at any time.
interface.defaultPrompt: Which of my amux workers are running right now?
